name.zh-Hant: 邁泰奧拉（天空之城修道院）
name.zh-Hans: 迈泰奥拉（天空之城修道院）

airspace.zh: 希臘適用歐盟的無人機規定：除了250公克以下、沒有相機等感測器的機種，飛手都要登記（歐盟以外的居民向希臘民航局HCAA登記），開放類別飛行高度上限120公尺；在自然保護區飛行須事先核准，飛越考古遺址須取得文化部許可，地理限制區要提前五個工作天申請，起降也要地主同意。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: EU drone rules apply in Greece: operators must register unless the drone is under 250 g and carries no camera or other sensor (residents outside the EU register with the Greek CAA, HCAA), and the Open category is limited to 120 m; flights in nature reserves need prior approval, flights over archaeological sites need Ministry of Culture permission, geographic zones need an application five working days ahead, and landowners must agree to take-offs. Check the current rules before any real flight.

meteora.note: Rock pillars between Kalabaka and Kastraki (39°42′51″N 21°37′52″E)

tagline.zh-Hant: 九世紀的隱修者、1356年的大邁泰奧拉、靠繩網上下的歲月，到1988年的世界遺產
tagline.en: Ninth-century hermits, Great Meteoron in 1356, centuries of nets and ladders, World Heritage in 1988

zh: 這裡是希臘中部塞薩利的邁泰奧拉，
岩柱頂上，蓋著一座座修道院。
en: This is Meteora in Thessaly, central Greece,
where monasteries stand on top of rock pillars.

zh: 「邁泰奧拉」的意思是「高懸的」，
和「流星」這個字，有同樣的字源。
en: "Meteora" means "lofty" or "elevated",
from the same root as "meteor".

zh: 九世紀起，隱修者搬上了這些岩柱；
到十一世紀，岩洞裡已經住著修士。
en: From the 9th century hermits moved onto the pinnacles;
by the 11th century monks were living in the caves.

zh: 他們在杜皮亞尼岩腳下的小教堂聚會禮拜，
那座十三世紀初的教堂，到今天還在使用。
en: They met for worship at a chapel at the foot of the Doupiani rock;
the early 13th-century chapel there is still in use.

zh: 1344年，來自聖山阿陀斯的阿塔納修斯，
帶著追隨者來到邁泰奧拉。
en: In 1344 Athanasios, a monk from Mount Athos,
brought his followers to Meteora.

zh: 1356到1372年間，他在最寬的岩柱上，
建起了大邁泰奧拉修道院。
en: Between 1356 and 1372, on the broadest rock,
he founded the Monastery of Great Meteoron.

zh: 資助他們的，是當地領主西美昂・烏羅什，
他在1356年自稱「塞爾維亞人與希臘人的皇帝」。
en: They were sponsored by the local lord Simeon Uroš,
who proclaimed himself "Emperor of Serbs and Greeks" in 1356.

zh: 到了十六世紀，這裡一共有二十四座修道院；
保存到今天的，只剩六座。
en: At their peak in the 16th century there were twenty-four monasteries;
six survive today.

zh: 過去上下岩柱，只能靠長梯，
或坐在大網裡，被繩索吊上去。
en: For centuries the only way up was by long ladders,
or in large nets hauled up on ropes.

zh: 相傳繩子只有在「上帝讓它斷掉」時才換；
直到1920年代，才在岩石上鑿出階梯。
en: The story goes that ropes were replaced only "when the Lord let them break";
steps were cut into the rock only in the 1920s.

zh: 山腳下的卡蘭巴卡，十世紀叫做斯塔戈伊，
是拜占庭的要塞，也是主教的駐地。
en: Kalabaka below was called Stagoi in the 10th century,
a Byzantine fortress and the seat of a bishop.

zh: 鎮上的聖母安眠主教座堂，
建於十一世紀末到十二世紀初，是唯一留存的中世紀建築。
en: Its Cathedral of the Dormition,
from the late 11th or early 12th century, is its only surviving medieval building.

zh: 鄂圖曼帝國統治這裡，一直到1881年；
那一年，塞薩利併入希臘王國。
en: Ottoman rule lasted until 1881,
when Thessaly passed to the Kingdom of Greece.

zh: 第二次世界大戰期間，這裡遭到轟炸；
1988年，邁泰奧拉列入世界遺產。
en: The site was bombed in the Second World War;
in 1988 Meteora became World Heritage.

zh: 從岩洞裡的隱修者，到岩柱頂上的修道院，
這裡的信仰，一直離天空很近。
en: From hermits in caves to monasteries on the pinnacles,
faith here has always lived close to the sky.

tagline.zh-Hant: 六百多卷手抄本、修女的修道院、龐德電影裡的聖三一，與山腳下的小鎮
tagline.en: Over 600 codices, a convent of nuns, Holy Trinity in a Bond film, and the town at the foot of the rocks

zh: 大邁泰奧拉是最大的修道院，
海拔六百一十三公尺，比河谷高出四百一十五公尺以上。
en: Great Meteoron is the largest monastery,
at 613 metres, over 415 metres above the floor of the Pineios valley.

zh: 六座修道院登錄的一千一百二十四部手抄本，
有六百一十部收藏在大邁泰奧拉。
en: Of the 1,124 codices catalogued in the six monasteries,
610 are kept at Great Meteoron.

zh: 瓦爾拉姆修道院海拔五百九十五公尺，
腳下的懸崖，比河谷高出三百七十三公尺。
en: Varlaam monastery stands at 595 metres,
on a cliff 373 metres above the valley floor.

zh: 聖斯德望修道院海拔五百七十五公尺，
1961年起，成為修女的修道院。
en: The Monastery of St Stephen stands at 575 metres;
since 1961 it has been a convent of nuns.

zh: 旁邊海拔五百一十公尺的庫庫拉斯峰，
俯瞰著這座修道院。
en: The 510-metre peak of Kukulas
looks down on the convent.

zh: 聖三一修道院在四百多公尺高的岩壁頂上，
穿過隧道，再爬一百多級石階，才到得了門口。
en: Holy Trinity sits on a precipice over 400 metres high;
you reach its door through tunnels and up more than a hundred stone steps.

zh: 它的全盛時期約有五十位修士，
到二十世紀初，只剩下五位。
en: At its height it had about fifty monks;
by the early 20th century five remained.

zh: 1981年的龐德電影《最高機密》，
把聖三一修道院拍成了反派的藏身處。
en: The 1981 James Bond film For Your Eyes Only
made Holy Trinity the villain's hideout.

zh: 它也出現在1957年的《海豚男孩》，
和1961年的《丁丁與金羊毛》。
en: It also appears in Boy on a Dolphin (1957)
and Tintin and the Golden Fleece (1961).

zh: 從卡蘭巴卡有一條三公里的步道，
可以一路走到聖三一修道院。
en: A 3 km footpath leads from Kalabaka
up to Holy Trinity.

zh: 山腳下的卡蘭巴卡，
2021年鎮上約有八千五百人。
en: Kalabaka, at the foot of the rocks,
had about 8,500 people in the town in 2021.

zh: 聖施洗約翰教堂牆上的希臘銘文，
證明這裡古代有一個叫做艾吉尼翁的聚落。
en: A Greek inscription in the wall of the Church of St John the Baptist
shows an ancient settlement here called Aiginion.

zh: 2018年，卡蘭巴卡所在的市鎮，
改名為「邁泰奧拉」。
en: In 2018 the municipality of Kalabaka
was renamed Meteora.

zh: 夏天，定期的遊覽巴士不斷開上山，
交通的壓力，也隨著遊客增加。
en: In summer, regular bus tours climb to the monasteries,
and traffic pressure grows with the visitors.

zh: 手抄本、修女的祈禱與電影的鏡頭，
都在這些岩柱上留下了痕跡。
en: Manuscripts, the nuns' prayers and the film camera
have all left their mark on these rocks.

tagline.zh-Hant: 一百六十三種鳥、消失中的白兀鷲、十八種蝙蝠，與河谷裡的懸鈴木
tagline.en: 163 bird species, a vanishing Egyptian vulture, 18 kinds of bat and plane trees in the valley

zh: 邁泰奧拉的岩柱之間，
記錄到一百六十三種鳥，其中一百二十種在這裡築巢。
en: Among the pillars of Meteora
163 bird species have been recorded, 120 of them nesting here.

zh: 猛禽有黑鳶、長腿鵟，
小烏鵰和地中海隼。
en: The raptors include black kites and long-legged buzzards,
lesser spotted eagles and lanner falcons.

zh: 白兀鷲曾在這些懸崖上繁殖，
但族群已經崩潰。
en: Egyptian vultures once bred on these cliffs,
but their population has collapsed.

zh: 2016年，保護區裡只剩一對；
2020年，整個區域只剩下一隻。
en: By 2016 only one pair remained in the site;
by 2020 only one bird was left in the wider area.

zh: 這裡記錄到十八種蝙蝠，
還有水獺、棕熊、狼與野貓。
en: Eighteen species of bat have been recorded here,
along with otters, brown bears, wolves and wildcats.

zh: 河谷裡，長著東方懸鈴木的河岸森林；
附近的山丘，有特有的矢車菊。
en: Riverine forests of oriental plane grow in the valley,
and endemic knapweeds grow on the nearby hills.

zh: 其中一種，就以卡蘭巴卡命名，
叫做「卡蘭巴卡矢車菊」。
en: One of them is named after the town:
Centaurea kalambakensis.

zh: 2020年，塞薩利的保護區管理單位成立，
負責照顧這裡的自然環境。
en: In 2020 a management unit for Thessaly's protected areas was set up
to look after the natural environment here.

zh: 緩衝區A禁止興建建築，
但正式的管理計畫，到現在還沒有完成。
en: Building is forbidden in buffer zone A,
but a management plan is still not available.

zh: 世界遺產的核心區約兩百七十二公頃，
緩衝區約一千八百八十四公頃。
en: The World Heritage core covers about 272 hectares,
with a buffer zone of about 1,884.

zh: 聖三一修道院的岩頂上，
有一座零點八公頃的花園。
en: On the summit rock of Holy Trinity
there is a garden of 0.8 hectares.

zh: 2025年，世界自然保護聯盟的評估，
把這裡的前景列為「良好，但有些問題要注意」。
en: IUCN's 2025 assessment
rated the outlook as "good, with some concerns".

zh: 同一份評估認為，這裡受到的威脅「低」，
保護與管理則「有些令人關切」。
en: The same assessment rates the threats as low,
and protection and management as "some concern".

zh: 猛禽、蝙蝠與稀有的花，
和修士們一起，住在這些岩柱之間。
en: Raptors, bats and rare flowers
share these pillars with the monks.

tagline.zh-Hant: 湖邊三角洲的砂岩與礫岩、六千萬年前的抬升、沿著斷層雕出的岩柱
tagline.en: Sandstone and conglomerate from a lakeside delta, uplift 60 million years ago, pillars carved along faults

zh: 邁泰奧拉的岩柱，是砂岩與礫岩，
不是火山留下的岩頸。
en: The pillars of Meteora are sandstone and conglomerate,
not volcanic plugs.

zh: 數百萬年間，溪流把石頭、砂與泥，
帶進湖邊的三角洲，慢慢堆成了礫岩。
en: Over millions of years streams carried stone, sand and mud
into a delta at the edge of a lake, building up the conglomerate.

zh: 大約六千萬年前，一連串地殼運動，
把這片沉積抬升成高原，也產生了垂直的斷層。
en: About 60 million years ago a series of earth movements
pushed these deposits up into a plateau, cracked by vertical faults.

zh: 水、風和劇烈的溫差，
沿著斷層侵蝕岩石，留下一根根岩柱。
en: Water, wind and extremes of temperature
wore the rock away along the faults, leaving pillar after pillar.

zh: 岩柱高出地面四百多公尺，
從平地上看，就像一座座石塔。
en: The pillars rise more than 400 metres above the ground,
like towers of stone from the plain below.

zh: 過去的隱修小室，
最高在比平地高出五百五十公尺的地方。
en: The hermits' cells
reached as high as 550 metres above the plain.

zh: 大邁泰奧拉海拔六百一十三公尺，
是修道院之中最高的一座。
en: Great Meteoron, at 613 metres,
is the highest of the monasteries.

zh: 它的正南方是「魔鬼塔」，
旁邊的伊普西洛特拉岩上，還留著一座修道院的廢墟。
en: Directly south of it stands the Devil's Tower,
and on the Ypsilotera rock beside it are the ruins of a former monastery.

zh: 魯薩努修道院海拔四百八十四公尺，
比大邁泰奧拉低了一百多公尺。
en: Rousanou monastery stands at 484 metres,
more than a hundred metres below Great Meteoron.

zh: 岩柱群位在卡蘭巴卡與卡斯特拉基村之間，
靠近皮尼奧斯河與品都斯山脈。
en: The pillars rise between Kalabaka and the village of Kastraki,
near the Pineios river and the Pindus Mountains.

zh: 卡蘭巴卡位在皮尼奧斯河的左岸，
岩柱一帶的水，都流進這條河谷。
en: Kalabaka lies on the left bank of the Pineios,
and the water of the rocks drains into its valley.

zh: 瓦爾拉姆修道院下方的南側，
有一個叫做「龍洞」的岩洞。
en: Below Varlaam monastery, to the south,
lies a cave called the Dragon Cave.

zh: 化學分析推算，這些岩壁大約有六千萬年。
而侵蝕，到今天都還在繼續。
en: Chemical analysis puts the cliffs at about 60 million years old,
and the weathering goes on today.

zh: 湖邊的三角洲、抬升的高原與一道道斷層，
一起雕出了這片懸在空中的岩柱。
en: A lakeside delta, a raised plateau and line after line of faults
together carved these pillars in the air.
